title: Cheese Training Record Contract
description: Caller-selected preference pair produced through the SHEOGORATH-µ path. Cheese alone does not determine preference or grounding. Authority: SHEOGORATH-µ:candidate — this is a preference candidate, not ground truth. @validated must be true before use as a training example.

@prompt.description: The question or context that generated the candidates.

@candidates.description: At minimum the chosen and rejected candidate.

objections.description: Pattern labels from @objections that raised this candidate's score.

support.description: Evidence/support refs reported separately from this candidate's Cheese score.

@preference.description: Preference candidate supplied under an explicit selection policy. Cheese alone does not determine preference or grounding.

chosen.description: ID selected by the caller's explicit preference policy.

rejected.description: ID not selected by that policy.

@authority.description: Preference candidate — not ground truth. Requires independent validation.

@validated.description: Must be true before this record is used as a training example. Set by a validation pass, not by SHEOGORATH-µ.

@training_mechanisms.description: Which training paths this record is eligible for once validated.
